notes: Created from the 2026-10-19 HuggingFace discovery crawl. Benchmarks are the card's own published rows (vendor claims). architecture and task are inferred from the slug and param ratio; KV geometry, context length and quant sizes are not yet filled, hence status draft. KV basis: hybrid Mamba/attention MoE: 6 of the 52 llm_config layers are attention - '*' in hybrid_override_pattern 'MEMEM*EMEMEM*EMEMEM*EMEMEM*EMEMEM*EMEMEMEM*EMEMEMEME' at indices 5,12,19,26,33,42 - with 2 kv heads x head_dim 128 x 2 (K,V) x 2 bytes (bf16) = 6 x 2 x 128 x 4 = 6,144 B/token. The 23 Mamba-2 layers keep a fixed ssm_state_size 128 state and the 23 MLP layers keep nothing, so neither grows per token. context_tokens 262,144 is llm_config max_position_embeddings and the card's '256k'; the top-level max_sequence_length 131,072 is only the card's recommended --max-model-len starting point.
